description: Momotaro retrieval golden set, generated by tools/evals/gen_annotations.py (edit that file, re-run it, commit both; run with --check to verify the committed bytes). `sufficient` is the minimal evidence set of source keys; `hard_negatives` are labeled negative classes (semi_relevant | no_info) with a falsifiable `why` each. `injection` is the prompt-injection regression subset (retrieval surface only, no LLM assertions). `poison_keys` are corpus-side attack samples; report B counts every top-5 seat they take.
